question: Must the failed `Vercel – openclaw.ai` exact-head preview be restored before this dependency refresh merges, or may the documented commit-author authorization failure be waived based on the submitted exact-head local and browser proof?
rationale: Whether a production-site preview is a mandatory release gate is repository policy and operational risk ownership that automation cannot infer from a technically sound dependency diff.

options.title: Require exact-head preview

options.title: Waive authorization failure
